title: Three Springs and One Short Plough
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：land　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 land 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 the farmer ① sowed the land that no tenant in the valley would have recorded, and he said the sowing was the whole of the spring. The ② land, meaning the soil itself and not the plough, ran three springs and stayed unrecorded in the book; land, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ piece of land in that valley had the same short plough beside it, and the ④ land at the far ridge, meaning the furrow they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Land, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the farmer said the recording is the part that fills three springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the land was the whole of the matter, meaning the promise and not the soil. The ⑥ land, meaning the promise and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; land, he said, is either something you sow or the only word that means both soil and a promise. He said the promise is the part they remember.

By 1954 the ⑦ land had become a line in a deed, and the deed had become an argument about the short plough. The ⑧ land of the whole thing, the farmer wrote in March, was one valley and three springs of recording; land, he said, is either the furrow at the far ridge or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ land I remember is the land recorded in the deed, which closed in 1956 and is still recorded as the quietest in the valley. ⑩ Land, my mother said in 1958, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all land, she said, is a promise that has agreed to look like soil. She said the promise was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 土地；田地（指山沟里每一块旁边的那一块）
B. n. 土地；田地（指那块土地本身，与犁相对）
C. 固定搭配：sow the land 耕种这块土地
D. n. 土地；田地（指留给孩子们撒种的那一垄那一块）
E. n. 耕种之事（抽象总称，指一处山沟的土地之事）
F. n. 土地；田地（指地契里写到、被记载的的那一块）
G. n. 指望、承诺（指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 承诺（抽象总称，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: sowed the land that no tenant in the valley would have recorded
The land, meaning the soil itself and not the plough
Every piece of land in that valley
the land at the far ridge
the land was the whole of the matter
the land had become a line in a deed
The land of the whole thing

answers.why: sow the land 意为“耕种这块土地”，1949 年那位农人把山沟里没有一位佃户肯记载的一块土地做了一遍。
land 意为“土地；田地”，指那块土地本身而不是犁，它经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被记载。
land 意为“土地；田地”，指山沟里每一块旁边的那一块，每一块旁边都有同一张小小的犁。
land 意为“土地；田地”，指最远那道田埂留给孩子们撒种的那一垄那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
land 意为“指望、承诺”，指一件事里人人都种却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份指望就是那件事的全部。
land 意为“承诺”，指人人都种却无人提起的那样东西而不是那块土地，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
land 意为“土地；田地”，指地契里写到、被记载的的那一块，到 1954 年这一块成了地契里的一行。
land 意为“耕种之事”，农人三月写道，整件事的土地之事是一处山沟和三个春天的记载。
land 意为“土地；田地”，我记得的是地契里记载过的那一块，1956 年分完了，至今仍被说成山沟里最安静的一块。
land 为抽象总称，母亲 1958 年说，土地是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的土地。

items: 1949 年那位农人耕种了山沟里没有一位佃户肯记载的一块土地，他说这一遍才是那个春天的全部。（sow the land）
那块土地，指的是那块土地本身而不是犁，经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被记载。（land）
那处山沟里每一块土地旁边都有同一张小小的犁。（land）
最远那道田埂那块土地，指的是他们留给孩子们撒种的那一垄那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（land）
叔叔说这份指望就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那块土地。（land）

Every piece of land in that valley had the same short plough beside it.
The land at the far ridge, meaning the furrow they kept for the children to sow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
